title: E-Commerce Website
shortDescription: A full-featured online shopping platform with user authentication, product catalog, cart, and payment integration.
description: A comprehensive e-commerce solution built with React and Node.js. Features include user registration/login with JWT authentication, dynamic product catalog with search and filter, shopping cart with persistent state, order management, and a responsive admin dashboard for product and inventory management.
features: Dynamic product catalog with search & filter
challenges: Implementing real-time inventory management while maintaining consistency across multiple concurrent user sessions was the primary challenge. Solved using optimistic UI updates with server-side validation.

title: Movie Ticket Booking
shortDescription: An interactive movie ticket booking platform with seat selection, booking management, and digital ticket generation.
description: A full-stack movie ticket booking system that enables users to browse currently running movies, select showtimes, interactively pick seats, and book tickets online. The system generates unique booking IDs and provides digital ticket downloads with QR codes.
features: Digital ticket generation with QR code
Movie search and filter by genre
challenges: Handling concurrent seat bookings to prevent double-booking required implementing database-level transaction locks and optimistic locking patterns in the Java backend.

title: Traffic Monitoring System
shortDescription: An IoT-based intelligent traffic monitoring system using sensors and computer vision for real-time traffic analysis.
description: An IoT-powered traffic monitoring solution that uses sensor arrays and embedded algorithms to detect vehicle density, analyze traffic flow, and dynamically adjust signal timings. The system includes a web dashboard for real-time monitoring and historical data visualization.
challenges: Synchronizing multiple sensor nodes across intersections with minimal latency while maintaining accurate vehicle count in high-density traffic scenarios required optimizing the embedded firmware and communication protocols.

title: Autonomous Line Following Robot
shortDescription: An autonomous robot that navigates complex paths using IR sensors and a PID controller implemented on Arduino.
description: A fully autonomous line-following robot designed and built using Arduino Uno, IR sensors, and a custom chassis. Implements a PID (Proportional-Integral-Derivative) control algorithm for smooth navigation and accurate path following. The robot can handle curves, intersections, and speed variations automatically.
challenges: Tuning PID constants for optimal performance across different track surfaces and lighting conditions required extensive empirical testing and the development of a serial monitor-based live tuning interface.
